finding.title: Scope LearningOrderDao.getLearningOrderByCurriculum/deleteAllForCurriculum by profileId to stop cross-sibling data leak
finding.why: learning_order's own composite PK is {profileId, curriculumId, sefariaRef} and saveOrder correctly stamps profileId on writes — but getOrder/resetToDefault read and delete by curriculumId alone. On any household with 2+ profiles sharing a curriculum (the app's core multi-child use case), profile B's getOrder() returns profile A's saved custom order (wrong order shown to the wrong child), and profile B tapping 'Reset to default' silently deletes profile A's saved custom order too — permanent cross-profile data loss with no confirmation naming the affected profile.
finding.recommendation: Add a required profileId parameter to LearningOrderDao.getLearningOrderByCurriculum/deleteAllForCurriculum, filter by t.profileId.equals(profileId) in both, and update the two call sites here to pass _profileId.
acceptance_criteria: Regression test: seed learning_order rows for 2 profiles on the same curriculum; profile B's getOrder() must not return profile A's rows and profile B's resetToDefault() must not delete profile A's rows
DAO methods require profileId as a compile-time parameter
